description: EXPLORATORY. Genericity check on my own merged result (#6634): mubar vanishes on all 606 triples of the derived carrier -- but is that special to the carrier? MEASURED: no. Random MONOTONE braid closures give 0 nonzero mubar over 1879 triples; random NON-MONOTONE ones give 27 over 1456. So the vanishing is a structural consequence of MONOTONICITY and says nothing about the framework's carrier CHOICE -- any monotone word would have given it. #6634's conclusion (route 3's Delta = 2 residual is closed) is UNAFFECTED; what changes is that the closure carries no information about whether the carrier is the right object. The non-monotone arm doubles as a second positive control: it proves the scan detects nonzero mubar in the RANDOM regime, not only on the hand-picked Borromean example. Independently corroborates the monotonicity root that #6561 reached from the algebra and #6560 from the topology. Scope (a): a sampling result over one random-word regime, not a theorem. Nothing wired.
